critical_threats.threat: Upstream maintainer account takeover publishes a malicious version
critical_threats.residual: A malicious change can appear legitimate if review and tests miss behavior.
Compromise of threshold signing authority can authorize malicious bytes.

critical_threats.threat: Dependency is deleted or yanked upstream
critical_threats.residual: Legal restrictions may compel deletion from project custody.

critical_threats.threat: Lockfile resolves to mutable or redirected content
critical_threats.residual: Ecosystem lock formats may omit important metadata.

critical_threats.threat: Package install script executes during intake or build
critical_threats.residual: Script exceptions enlarge the trusted code surface.

critical_threats.threat: Compromised compiler or public binary cache injects artifacts
critical_threats.residual: Reproducible compromise in the compiler bootstrap chain remains possible.

critical_threats.threat: Freeze or rollback attack serves stale metadata and vulnerable packages
critical_threats.residual: Offline clients need reliable time or a bounded trusted-time strategy.
